interpretation.finite_run_labels: no_growth_detected and growth_detected are evidence labels, not proofs of positive recurrence or instability
interpretation.ramp_gap: each equal-load segment reuses its task and disturbance pattern; up/down separation relative to the matched empty-start replay is dynamic memory, not evidence of static bistability
interpretation.fold_diagnostic: the parameter-free curve is shown only as a reference; the single-gate data neither cover its varying domain nor contain an independently detected fold
interpretation.finite_fleet: the physical-fleet sweep enforces active + returning + available = N at every integration step
interpretation.open_branching: the scalar in-sample resolvent is flagged as a chain-forest identity; open_heldout_branching.csv scores only independent replications and does not identify supercriticality
